prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Pet Photo Diagnostics Split Layout: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a split layout with real-time photo quality feedback and live mascot preview. (why: Adoption drops to 63.2% and 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results.)
1: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Badge Verification Callout: Adds safety and quality verification badges on the adoption certificate screen prior to final generation. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 63.2% and high drop-off before rendering starts.)
2: [home, new_screen] Pre-Home Desktop Visibility Check Screen: Inserts a desktop display verification check screen after waiting to confirm the pet is visible on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or app not opening after waiting.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Path Teaser & Quick Jump: Updates story screen headline and body text to clearly explain what desktop pets do before picking a path. (why: Improves choose_path funnel progression and reduces 514s mean dwell time.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in Recovery Guarantee Notice: Adds an explicit account data guarantee hint under sign in buttons to reassure users that previous pets won't be lost. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
